<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_SupplierOnboarding" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/supplier-onboarding">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RFP" name="Request for proposals"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Proposal" name="Supplier proposal"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SupplierOnboarding">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Procurement" name="Company / Procurement Team" processRef="Process_SupplierOnboarding"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RFP" name="RFP" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Participant_Supplier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Proposal" name="Proposal" sourceRef="Participant_Supplier" targetRef="Event_ProposalsReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_SupplierOnboarding" name="Supplier Selection and Onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" name="Need for new supplier identified"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueRFP" name="Issue request for proposals (RFP)" messageRef="Message_RFP"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProposalsReceived" name="Supplier proposals received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Proposals" messageRef="Message_Proposal"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateProposals" name="Evaluate proposals (cost, quality, delivery time)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitDecision" name="Site visits or interviews needed?" default="Flow_NoVisit"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SiteVisitInterview" name="Conduct site visits or interviews with suppliers"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitMerge" name="Merge before selection"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectSupplier" name="Analyze results and select supplier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateContract" name="Negotiate contract terms"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnboardSupplier" name="Onboard supplier"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Onboarded" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_IssueRFP" targetRef="Event_ProposalsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Event_ProposalsReceived" targetRef="Task_EvaluateProposals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateProposals" targetRef="Gateway_VisitDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisitYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitDecision" targetRef="Task_SiteVisitInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${visitsOrInterviewsRequired == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoVisit" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitDecision" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AfterVisit" sourceRef="Task_SiteVisitInterview" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitMerge" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateContract" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="EndEvent_Onboarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
